usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/didit/v3/database-validation with JSON body {issuing_state, validation_type, identification_number} (required) plus optional first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, document_type, expiration_date, nationality, address depending on country
quirks: issuing_state must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code from the supported set: ARG, BOL, BRA, CHL, COL, CRI, DOM, ECU, ESP, GTM, HND, MEX, PAN, PER, PRY, SLV, URY, VEN (Latin America + Spain only)
identification_number is a universal field that auto-maps to the country-specific registry format (e.g. CURP for Mexico)
Some countries require extra fields: ESP requires document_type and expiration_date; provide first_name/last_name/date_of_birth for two_by_two checks

A non-existent or invalid ID returns HTTP 200 with status='Declined' and match_type='no_match' — this is a successful CALL, not an error; read database_validation.status to determine the actual KYC result
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://x402.orth.sh/didit/v3/database-validation with a JSON body containing at minimum issuing_state (alpha-3 country code from the supported Latin America + Spain set), validation_type ('one_by_one' or 'two_by_two'), and identification_number. Pay $0.31 USDC on Base via x402. The call returns HTTP 200 with a structured result; read body.database_validation.status ('Approved' or 'Declined') and body.database_validation.match_type to determine whether the identity matched the national registry, and inspect body.database_validation.validations[] for per-registry detail. A 'Declined'/'no_match' response means the ID was not found (the service still worked).
